brief:
Gaza's health ministry, Shehab Wire reported, condemned the obstruction of medical evacuations, stating that only five patients accompanied by five caregivers were permitted to travel to Jordan today, far below the 75 children scheduled for treatment abroad.

The ministry did not specify which authority blocked the evacuation of the remaining 70 children or provide details on their medical conditions or required treatments.
